"''I don't understand the question.|[[Joss Adren]] speaks to the Arkanian [[Visma Tarko]]|{{InsiderCite|224|Tales from the Occlusion Zone: Survivors}}}} '''Arkania''' was a [[Temperature|cold]] [[planet]] located in the [[Arkania system]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Colonies]] region, positioned at the coordinates M-8 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. It was the [[homeworld]] of [[Arkanian]] [[species]]. ==Description== The [[Temperature|cold]] [[planet]] Arkania sat within the [[Arkania system]] of the [[Colonies]] region of [[the galaxy]] at coordinates M-8 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]'' The [[Arkanian]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|hailed]] from Arkania. As a result of life on the frigid planet, the Arkanians would develop infrared vision over the course of their evolution. Root vegetables were a staple crop on Arkania. The world''[[The High Republic: Cataclysm]]'' shared its name with the [[Species|creatures]] known as [[Arkanian dragon]]s.[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] ==History== By the year [[228 BBY]],According to ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'', the [[Guardian Protocols]] were implemented in [[229 BBY]]. According to [[The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1|''Shadows of Starlight'' 1]], this happened one week after the [[Destruction of Starlight Beacon]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places in [[230 BBY]]. The events of ''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'', including the [[Expansion of the Stormwall]], take place exactly one year after the Fall of [[Starlight Beacon]]. The events of "[[Tales from the Occlusion Zone: Friend or Foe?]]" and "[[Tales from the Occlusion Zone: Survivors]]" take place one month after the Expansion of the [[Stormwall]], so they must be set in [[228 BBY]]. the [[Tarkos family]] had been, for [[Standard century|centuries]] by that point, among the most illustrious families who called Arkania home. Members of the clan arose to positions like [[general]], [[governor]], that of top [[scientist]], and even [[Jedi]]. In the [[Standard week|weeks]] following the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic]] was involved in a [[battle on Arkania]] that included ground-level fighting.[[Alphabet Squadron
